description: Main-window capability, least-privilege. core:default = IPC to the 3 bridge commands (start/send/stop) + event listen for rpc:// frames. dialog:default = the workspace folder picker (pickWorkspaceFolder). The three opener grants are each used: allow-open-url (OAuth/external links via openExternalUrl), allow-open-path + allow-reveal-item-in-dir (reveal workspace/session in the OS file manager, AppShell). updater:default = check/download signed updates; process:allow-restart = relaunch after an update installs. No fs/shell/http capability is granted — all filesystem and process work happens in the engine sidecar, never the WebView.
